steps.content: The alarm keeps blaring through the hallways, the nerve-wracking booms sounding like countdowns from the depths of the WhiteSands.

Milly walks down the corridor with a beaming smile. The golden cords of her dress sways with each step, like ominous signs trailing in Death's wake. Each click of her heels against the floor meets the beat of the alarm, creating a strange, ritualistic rhythm.
The guests are gone, leaving only panicked staff members and performers. When they spot Milly, the dancers rush toward her, desperate to know what's happening.

steps.speaker: Snow
steps.content: Milly! What's going on? Where are we supposed to go? Are we evacuating?!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Shh... keep it down. The show's not over yet.
She puts a finger to her lips in a playful shushing gesture.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: No one is coming for you. The ship is going down. Where would you go?
Sensing something off, Snow uses her ability the moment Milly draws near, blasting snow and ice shards before turning to run. But it's too late.
Milly's puppets move like shadows, tackling Snow to the ground before she can turn.

steps.speaker: Snow
steps.content: Milly! You...!
Milly extends her finger, lightly touching its honey to the dancer's forehead. Snow's pupils contract, and her body goes limp.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You can't escape on your own. I'm just making it easier for you.
The dancer lies motionless on the floor, her eyes vacant. The others, finally realizing something is wrong, scramble to flee, screaming and banging against doors.
But the puppets have already surrounded them silently, blocking every exit. There is no slaughter, only their silent, menacing advance.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: No need to rush. Let's do it one at a time. Next, please...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: And where have my two friends gone?
The golden cord in her hand sways rhythmically, no longer a beautiful ornament, but the noose of Death.
Click... clack... clack...
Through a crack in the door, Sallie watches the massacre, eyes wide with horror. She clamps a hand over her mouth, terrified of making a single sound.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...Who is that?
The blonde woman's smile is radiant. She hums a cheerful tune, but her performance brings her audience nothing but pain and despair.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: That's not Milly! I don't know who that is!
She trembles and backs away, turning to shake Cassian. He's curled up in agony, head in his hands. Sweat soaks his temples, and only muffled groans escape his lips.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...We can't stay here. Cassian! Are you okay? Can you run?!

She throws herself at him, shaking his shoulders. Maybe her efforts do work, or perhaps Milly's influence has waned, for Cassian's eyes begin to focus as he comes to his senses, though he's still covered in cold sweat.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Sallie...
Cassian rasps her name, beckoning her closer.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Listen. You can't stop her. No one can. If this continues... she'll kill everyone.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: No, there's still a chance, we can...
Cassian manages a weak smile and nods.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: There is. But you'll have to go alone. Take this...
He presses something into her hand. A key, and the communicator that nearly got them killed. He had hidden it away. His body has almost given out; he can only lean against the wall for support.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: I told you before, I prepared an escape route for myself. There's a small boat hidden at the end.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: The guests' boats are gone by now. Mr. E will make sure the lifeboats are all destroyed...

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Don't worry. Mine's disguised. You'll find it.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Run. Get help. Live...
Sallie starts to protest, but the screams from the corridor are death knells, each sending a jolt through their nerves.
Cassian pushes her toward the hidden door with all his strength.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: There's a corridor outside. Keep running, go to the fifth floor...

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: How could I possibly escape... I...

Cassian looks at her. He's seen that look countless times before, on faces that were once innocent, or angry, or filled with want... faces once so full of life, slowly hollowed out by this hell until they became the same mask. He's seen it so many times he thought he'd gone numb.
But this time... is it because he's seen the ghosts of his loved ones, because he knows his own end is near? This time, Cassian wants to do something.
For once, he forces an unfamiliar smile for Sallie.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: If you've lost the will to escape for yourself, then do it as a favor to me.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Get out of here for me. Show the world the truth about this place, its darkness. That will be my revenge...

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Go. I still have some strength left. I can buy you time.
Click... clack... The sound of heels is getting closer.
Without hesitating, Cassian pries Sallie's fingers from the door. He slams it shut and locks it from his side, silencing her cries.
Behind the hidden door, tears stream down Sallie's face.

Through the wood, she hears the click-clack of heels stop where Cassian had been. A familiar laugh rings out. Sallie grits her teeth, forces herself up on trembling legs, and staggers down the dark passage.
